ios.desc:
Slop is your antidote to the AI-generated feed.

Discover masterpieces created by actual humans across 5,000 years of history from the Renaissance to the Hudson River School, Baroque to Byzantine.

No AI garbage. Just pure, human-made art.

Features

Curated collection of classical masterpieces

Vertical scrolling feed designed for discovery

Learn about each artwork’s history and context

Save your favorites to revisit anytime

Why Slop?

In a world drowning in AI-generated content, Slop celebrates the craftsmanship, emotion, and genius of human artists. Every painting, every brushstroke made by human hands, not machines.

Dive into art history.
Escape the slop.

quotes.text:
AI images pretending to be art, fake creativity, infinite noise. I realized I was scrolling constantly and seeing nothing made by an actual person.

So I made *Slop*.

It’s doomscrolling, but only with real human art like paintings, sculptures, manuscripts, weird old illustrations all created long before generative AI existed.

If you’re sick of AI aesthetics and still like to scroll: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/slop-real-human-art/id6758466824
